definitions.explanation: Materials used for teaching and learning, including textbooks, workbooks, handouts, digital content, and other instructional resources.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{教材|きょうざい}を{作成|さくせい}した。
オンラインの{教材|きょうざい}で{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}している。
examples.english: I'm studying Japanese using online educational materials.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{歴史|れきし}の{教材|きょうざい}としても{活用|かつよう}できる。
examples.english: This film can also be used as a teaching resource for history.

notes:
USAGE:
Covers a broad range of materials from traditional textbooks to digital learning content. In modern usage, デジタル{教材|きょうざい} (digital teaching materials) and オンライン{教材|きょうざい} (online materials) are increasingly common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教材|きょうざい}を{作|つく}る: to create teaching materials
- {教材|きょうざい}を{活用|かつよう}する: to make use of teaching materials
- {教材|きょうざい}{開発|かいはつ}: teaching material development
- デジタル{教材|きょうざい}: digital teaching materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {教科書|きょうかしょ}: textbook (a specific type of teaching material)
- {参考書|さんこうしょ}: reference book, study guide
